name: Sezon meduz
source:
A fat man named Niklas meets a strange girl on the beach. She writes poetry and says that she is dead.

[From [url=https://kombinat.itch.io/jellyfish-season] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个名叫尼克拉斯的胖子在海滩上遇到了一个陌生的女孩。她写诗并说她已经死了。

[来自[url=https://kombinat.itch.io/jellyfish-season] itch.io[/url]]
